displayName: Every metric in the catalog is unique, bucketed, documented, and assigned a dashboard
Every metric is charted on its dashboard, and every dashboard UID is in server-info
Every REST route, MCP tool, and A2A method has a row in the coverage matrix
Requests record route-template metrics, database statements, background iterations, and auth failures
A run records per-agent lifecycle, stage, token, and worker metrics with tenant, agent, deployment, harness, and model labels
MCP tool calls record duration by tool and result, and sessions are counted
The cardinality guard folds values beyond the limit into other and counts them
Throwing trace and metric consumers cannot change the application result or original exception
Application spans classify error and cancellation without exception values; intrinsic gateway timing excludes tool execution
Database statement names carry the operation and table, never values
Parallel unrelated queries never contaminate exact counts; nested same-run work is counted once and concurrent scopes atomically accumulate
Failed SQL attempts persist without SQL text, other tenants cannot read attribution, and run deletion cleans usage
